messages:
Ethan Lo: Morning — first week and quick question: HR says my laptop will be enrolled in Jamf and SSO will use FIDO2 key + biometrics. If I use Touch ID on the Mac, will we be able to remote-wipe if lost? Don't want personal photos wiped. Also curious about whether biometrics are stored locally only. Thanks!
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ethan :wave: Company devices are enrolled in Jamf and remote-wipe is possible, but it targets corporate data containers; we don't wipe personal iCloud or user personal partitions by default. Please keep personal data minimal. Biometrics (Touch ID/Face ID) are stored in the Secure Enclave locally — we don't have a copy.
Ethan Lo: That's a relief. If I enroll a personal device for MFA (Okta) and later lose it, can you block access without a wipe?
Raj (Security): Yes — we can revoke device sessions and block tokens via Okta. Wipe is only for company-managed devices. For personal MFA devices we disable the factor and force re-auth. Also enable a strong passcode.
IT-helpdesk: Note: company loaners are configured with separate user accounts and a managed data container. Remote-wipe triggers a selective wipe that removes the corporate account and container only.
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Security Essentials (Onboarding)" due in 72h. PhishSim scheduled for next Wednesday; new joiners exempt first 7 days.
Ethan Lo: Cool. One more small thing: will Jamf install any apps that use my camera/mic by default?
Raj (Security): We don't install apps that access camera/mic without a business need. Any privacy-sensitive software deployment is opt-in and documented. If you see unexpected prompts DM us.
Maya (People Ops): DMing the device policy summary + selective-wipe FAQ (https://intranet.redwood/device-wipe-faq). Ping if you want the loaner instead of enrolling personal device.
Ethan Lo: Thanks all — enrolling the company Mac when it arrives and will keep personal device MFA as fallback.
